title: Minimum Number of Increments on Subarrays to Form a Target Array
description:
You are given an integer array target.

You start with another array initial of the same length, where all elements are 0.

Operation

In one operation:

Choose any contiguous subarray of initial
Increment every element in that subarray by 1
Task

Return the minimum number of operations required to transform initial into target.
input_format: The first line contains an integer n, the length of the target array. The second line contains n space-separated integers representing the target array.
output_format: Print a single integer representing the minimum number of operations required.
constraints:
1 ≤ n ≤ 10⁵
1 ≤ target[i] ≤ 10⁵
Answer fits in a 32-bit integer
